rows.grounds: compound describing agents constituted by bondage of existence

items.question: What effect does knowing this principle have on those constituted by worldly bondage?
premises: This principle can be directly known.
Some beings are constituted by the bondage of worldly existence.
Knowledge of the principle is addressed as transformative for such beings.
items.inference: Knowing this principle brings about a decisive change in relation to the bondage of worldly existence.
uncertainties: The specific result of knowing is not explicitly stated in this verse alone.
The syntactic completion of the sentence depends on the following context.
items.plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, having known this principle, those constituted by the bondage of worldly existence...
